blocks.text: Anthropic 于周一提交了上市申请，其 S-1 文件为我们在 Every 观察到的一个现象给出了数字：当新模型发布时，我们中的许多人会把它切换为日常主力。发布超过六个月的模型贡献的收入不到 Anthropic 总收入的 20%。今天，我们解析这对你该选用哪个模型意味着什么。另外：评测负责人 Mike Taylor 谈如何看起来像专家却保持通才本色、他如何在早晨喝咖啡的工夫让 Claude 把网站从 Webflow 迁移出来，以及我们聊得停不下来的行业新闻。——Kate Lee

blocks.text: Anthropic filed to go public on Monday, and its S-1 puts a number on something we’ve seen at Every: When a new model drops, many of us switch to it as our daily driver. Models older than six months earn less than 20 percent of Anthropic’s revenue. Today, we unpack what that means for which model you should be using. Plus: head of evals Mike Taylor on how to look like a specialist while staying a generalist, how he had Claude move his website off Webflow over morning coffee, and the industry stories we couldn’t stop talking about.—Kate Lee
